# Ultimate Audio test reference

These files are exact copies from GideonZ/1541ultimate commit
`fea2798c217674cf0e6eddb121792f3a214ddd9f`:
https://github.com/GideonZ/1541ultimate/tree/fea2798c217674cf0e6eddb121792f3a214ddd9f

They are licensed under the repository's GNU General Public License version 3,
reproduced in `upstream/LICENSE.txt`. The sampler, math and bus-package files
have no separate license notice. `srl_fifo-generic.vhd` has a copyright notice
for Gideon's Logic B.V. and relies on the repository license. Original notices
and original file bytes are preserved. `import_manifest.json` records SHA-256
and Git blob identities for every imported file.

This is a test-only independent reference for the Multitini sampler's register,
voice and mixer behavior. It is excluded from the FPGA and ARM product builds.
The restricted `lp_filter` implementations, Commodore ROMs, music, software
binaries and other media are not included.
